form.label: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for PAN-OS CSV syslog families routed to pan:* sourcetypes. Dashboard presence does not imply SC4S/Splunk replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ vendor="Palo Alto Networks" product="PAN-OS" | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ action IN (block,block-url,deny,drop,reset-both,reset-client,reset-server) | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ severity IN (high,critical) | stats count
index=$index$ (sourcetype="pan:config" OR sourcetype="pan:auth" OR sourcetype="pan:globalprotect" OR sourcetype="pan:userid") host=$host_filter$ | stats count

chart.title: Volume over time by PAN-OS sourcetype

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ | timechart count by sourcetype
index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ | eval action_result=coalesce(action,result,pan_subtype,"unknown") | top limit=15 action_result
index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ | eval severity=coalesce(severity,"unknown") | top limit=10 severity
index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ | eval application_or_protocol=coalesce(app,transport,pan_subtype,"unknown") | top limit=15 application_or_protocol

index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ | eval src=coalesce(src,src_ip), dest=coalesce(dest,dest_ip) | stats count values(action) as actions values(app) as apps values(transport) as transports values(dest_port) as dest_ports values(rule) as rules by src dest | sort - count | head 25

index=$index$ sourcetype IN ("pan:traffic","pan:threat","pan:wildfire","pan:decryption","pan:tunnel","pan:correlation") host=$host_filter$ (action IN (block,block-url,deny,drop,alert) OR severity IN (high,critical)) | table _time host sourcetype pan_type pan_subtype action severity src src_ip src_port dest dest_ip dest_port app transport rule user category signature signature_id threat_id url marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

table.title: Traffic, decryption, GTP, and SCTP flow context

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype IN ("pan:traffic","pan:decryption","pan:gtp","pan:sctp","pan:tunnel") host=$host_filter$ | table _time sourcetype action src src_ip src_port dest dest_ip dest_port app transport rule user session_id bytes bytes_in bytes_out packets session_end_reason source_zone destination_zone marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

index=$index$ sourcetype IN ("pan:threat","pan:wildfire","pan:correlation") host=$host_filter$ | table _time sourcetype action severity src src_ip dest dest_ip app url file_name category threat_id signature signature_id user direction correlation_name object marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

index=$index$ sourcetype IN ("pan:config","pan:system") host=$host_filter$ | table _time sourcetype user client result command admin_role config_path object event_id module severity pan_message action signature signature_id dvc serial marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

table.title: Identity, auth, HIP, and GlobalProtect context

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype IN ("pan:auth","pan:globalprotect","pan:userid","pan:hipmatch","pan:iptag") host=$host_filter$ | table _time sourcetype user src src_ip dest dest_ip action result auth_profile portal gateway server host_name os hip_profile tag object signature signature_id marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

table.title: Onboarding coverage by source, host, and sourcetype

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers values(action) as actions values(severity) as severities min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

index=$index$ sourcetype="pan:*" host=$host_filter$ | table _time host source sourcetype pan_type pan_subtype serial action result severity src src_ip src_port dest dest_ip dest_port app rule user signature signature_id marker _raw | sort - _time | head 100
